notes.title: Hearts of Iron III security update May 4th
notes.notes:
Hi!

After discovering a minor potential securty problem we decided to patch the game to correct it. 

[code]Patch notes:
- Fixed additional Lua vulnerabilities
[/code]

This should not change anything noticeable for you in your game. But there is the small possibility that mods you are using may be utilizing the security flaw in a non-malicious way and may therefore stop working with this patch. 

If that's the case, you can revert your game version by right clicking the game in Steam -> properties -> BETAS and select the "4.02-no_security_fix..." version. Please note that you do that on your own risk! That version does contain a known security flaw!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hearts of Iron III Security Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

To resolve a security issue tied to the way LUA libraries were loaded for mods we released a minor update. This update will not change your version number or cheksum, and save files should be unaffected.

The update has already been applied through Steam.

[code]
To prevent IO or system/OS access in Lua (to prevent mods abusing it), we want to disable the `luaopen_io` and `luaopen_os` functions in the LUA library/dll.
These are updated LUA libraries with that functionality disabled.

This does not change behavior of the base game, or impact the multiplayer checksum. Some mods might use these libraries for benign purposes, but unfortunately they will not function after this fix.
[/code]

notes.title: New Release - Hearts of Iron III: Mega German Spritepack
notes.notes:
The Mega German Spritepack, the newest upgrade for Hearts of Iron III, is now available on Steam!

The Mega German Spritepack introduces 87 new animated 3D Model as well as new equipment and weaponry for each unit.

To celebrate this release, the Hearts of Iron III Collection is available at 75% off until August 30th at 10AM Pacific Time!

notes.title: New Release - Hearts of Iron III: For the Motherland
notes.notes:
For the Motherland, the latest expansion for Hearts of Iron III is now available on Steam!

It’s time to dust off the field marshal's baton and take command of any nation in World War II; the largest conflict in history.
